correctness.rationale: The real symmetric irreducible Jacobi generator has simple spectrum and positive exponential Gram H_T for every T>0. Spectral Vandermonde factorization gives det W_j=F(T,p,q,r)(det K_j)^2 with site-independent F>0. Direct exact symbolic independent computation of four Krylov determinants gives pq²r*(p²,-A,-B,r²); signs match. Comparing affine A=p(p-2r)-(p-r)q, B=r(r-2p)+(p-r)q, A+B=Delta and threshold displacement theta-2p=-Delta/(p-r) proves every p/r regime including Delta=0 and p=r ties; reflection handles p<r. Three-vertex middle score (p-q)^2 is strictly smaller than max(p²,q²), and explicit four-node positive witnesses show minimality. A 7^3 rational interpolation checker gives an exact polynomial identity; finite phase trials only corroborate the analytic continuum inequalities.
residual_risks: Single direct equal-noise scalar sensor, four-node symmetric positive conductance path, positive finite horizon; no multi-sensor or alternate criterion.
